item.title: Rahane snubs MS Dhoni, Virat Kohli; names India's greatest-ever cricketer
item.summary: Ajinkya Rahane recently retired from all cricket formats. He named Sachin Tendulkar as India's greatest-ever cricketer. Tendulkar had a remarkable 24-year international career for India. Rahane played alongside Tendulkar in domestic and IPL matches. He also captained India in all three formats.
